# Perfora

> > Perfora is an Indian oral care brand offering clinically proven teeth whitening, electric toothbrushes, toothpastes, and comprehensive dental care products with innovative formulations.

Perfora specializes in premium oral care products including teeth whitening strips and serums, sonic electric toothbrushes, SLS-free toothpastes, and specialized solutions for sensitivity and fresh breath. The brand emphasizes scientific formulations using ingredients like nano-hydroxyapatite, activated charcoal, and zinc citrate, and offers a dedicated Perfora Junior line for children.
